content: This paper presents a new method for jointly selecting features and classifying longitudinal functional data with categorical outcomes, integrating logistic loss and functional principal components. By introducing an adaptive Dual Augmented Lagrangian algorithm that exploits sparsity for dimensionality reduction, the approach efficiently handles high-dimensional healthcare data, as shown through simulations and a real-world study of chronic diseases and related factors.
